scope: reviewer-owned record only. No implementation, evidence, generator, verifier or historical record was modified. This lane does not own the fix.
headline: Canonical-layout re-emission cannot move platform_ready. Both approval channels require two classification fields that 113 of 114 committed field-classification.json files do not carry.
materiallyDifferentFrom: The war-room controlling assumption that platform_ready reaches 5 once the four approval records are discovered in canonical layout. Re-emission is necessary but not sufficient; on current bytes it moves the count by zero.

theClause.appliesTo: both overlayProfileApproval and reviewRecordApproval — it is the clause the two channels share, so neither channel can bypass it
theClause.refusal: the field or anchor classification is not complete
theClause.whyItAlwaysFires: When the two keys are absent both sides are Number(undefined) === NaN, and NaN !== NaN is true, so the comparison refuses before the zero check is reached.

provenByRunningTheRealGate.reason: independent review approved these exact bytes after 4 round(s)
provenByRunningTheRealGate.note: this is the current platform_ready = 1, and it is the only family whose classification carries the counts

provenByRunningTheRealGate.reason: the field or anchor classification is not complete
provenByRunningTheRealGate.note: clears all twelve conditions of reviewRecordApproval first — verdict, record verifier, independence, source binary, field map, classification hash, every artifact, provenance sidecar, visual evidence, no open correction, currency, asset identity

isolation: Populating only discoveredFieldsOrAnchors and classifiedFieldsOrAnchors in a scratch copy outside the repository, with the record re-pinned to the edited file, makes AK:tf-800-form-en and AK:tf-805-form-en return "canonical independent-review record wave-c-final-a approved these exact bytes, and all twelve conditions hold" through channel independent_review_record. Nothing else was changed, so the clause is the sole remaining blocker for these records.
consequenceForTheDenominator: No reviewer's canonical re-emission — wave-c-final-a for AK, or the NC reviewer's equivalent — can raise platform_ready above 1 while the classification writers omit these fields. The expected target platform_ready = 5 is unreachable on current bytes.

exactFix.owner: the lane that owns the field-classification generator (not this review lane)
exactFix.change: emit discoveredFieldsOrAnchors and classifiedFieldsOrAnchors in rcap-field-classification/v4-nine-class and v1, as rcap-field-classification/v2-complete already does. For the four families in this shard the value is the length of entries[] and the two are equal.
exactFix.doNotDoInstead: Do not relax the clause in rcap-platform-ready.mjs. It is a real completeness gate and weakening it to create movement is out of bounds; the classification files are what is incomplete, not the gate.
exactFix.afterTheFix: Re-pin fieldClassificationSha256 in any batch manifest that names an affected family, since changing the classification file changes its hash and condition 5 compares it. wave-c-final-a will need exactly that re-pin, which this lane will do on request.
